top_events.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
top_events.label: AfD wins 44% in German state election
top_events.summary: Far-right party projected to win Saxony-Anhalt with 44%, far ahead of conservatives at 17%. First far-right state government in Germany since WWII reshapes EU political landscape.

top_events.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
top_events.label: Ukraine war extends into winter 2025
top_events.summary: No breakthrough after US envoy talks in Kyiv. War on Poland's eastern border continues without resolution, maintaining regional security pressure and refugee flows.

top_events.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
top_events.label: Iran threatens escalation after US strikes
top_events.summary: Tehran warns of stronger retaliation after US struck Iranian oil tankers. Rhetoric only, no new action yet; potential for energy price volatility if conflict escalates.
